generations.name: Second generation (Tesla powertrain)
generations.notes: Tesla-supplied powertrain: 41.8 kWh usable Panasonic pack (35 kWh in standard charge mode), 10 kW (some sources 9.6 kW) onboard AC, no factory DC fast charging. Sold only in California, about 2,600 units; ended September 2014. Named second generation because the 1997-2003 RAV4 EV predates our scope. EPA label prefix "RAV4 EV" so RAV4 hybrids/PHEVs could never be caught. US only. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toyota_RAV4_EV
